phaseRoutingNote: Never in round 2's plan -- discovered live while executing the r0-5 kill/resume canary test itself (the last missing DoD item of US-486's T-7 Canary): archiving a finished run directory for story 136 by renaming it with the session's own `_archived-<name>` prefix, then launching a fresh run for the same story, produced status:'other-run' redirecting straight back into the archived directory -- resolve()'s two readdirSync(runsRoot) scans (the other-run/ambiguous-runs candidate scan, and the sibling-contradiction-key scan) never excluded a reserved/non-canonical prefix. Filed as the next sequential group in round 2's batch, directly authored and sealed by the orchestrator (dispatchesPerStory cap blocks any further agent-dispatched resolve() redirect here), same as r2-g4 through r2-g7.
sourceOfTruth: cycle-state.mjs's resolveState() (both readdirSync(runsRoot) scans) cross-checked live: `.pair/working/runs/136-cycle-codex-v6` renamed to `_archived-136-attempt3-cycle-codex-terra` and left inside `.pair/working/runs/`, then `pair-implement-batch` relaunched for story 136 with a fresh runId -- resolve() returned `{status:'other-run', runId:'_archived-136-attempt3-cycle-codex-terra'}` instead of `status:'empty'`. Fix verified by unblocking the archived directory (moved outside `.pair/working/runs/` as a workaround) before this contract existed; this contract makes the workaround unnecessary going forward.

inventory.producer: cycle-state.mjs's resolveState() -- the two readdirSync(runsRoot) scans that look for a sibling run directory of the same story (the other-run/ambiguous-runs candidate scan when the current dir is empty, and the sibling-contradiction-key scan that runs on every resolve)
inputs: A runsRoot containing a directory renamed with the `_archived-` prefix (the ONLY archiving convention ever used in this repo's history -- introduced ad hoc this session, never previously exercised against a live resolve() call) that still holds a compatible, non-empty handoff set for the same story
A fresh, genuinely empty run directory for that same story
representations: resolveState()'s candidates filter (readdirSync(runsRoot).filter(...)) and its sibling-contradiction-key loop (for (const r of readdirSync(runsRoot)))
cycle-coordinator.test.mjs's AC12-w3 mirror-identity check, which now covers a sixth location (pair-workflow-cycle) alongside the five phase skills and their dataset mirrors
consumers: every fresh-entry dispatch of any phase skill for a story whose prior run was moved aside with the `_archived-` convention
the US-486 r0-5 kill/resume canary itself, which depends on archiving being a real exclusion to free a story for a repeatable test
classes: C1 (the defect, live at inputHead before this fix) -- a `_archived-<name>` directory with a compatible handoff set for the target story is treated as a live candidate: alone it is wrongly adopted as `other-run`, alongside a real candidate it wrongly contributes to `ambiguous-runs`, and its `contradiction` handoffs (if any) wrongly contribute to the sibling-contradiction-key budget

C2 (target state) -- any runsRoot entry whose name starts with `_` is excluded from BOTH scans unconditionally, so it is exactly as if the directory did not exist for resolve() purposes; a genuine sibling run alongside it is still adopted normally
interactions: I1 -- the reserved-prefix exclusion is a NEW convention, not a rename of an existing one: nothing in the shipped skills, docs or tests previously assigned meaning to a leading underscore in a runsRoot entry name, so this fix introduces the rule rather than repairing a broken one

I2 -- both scan sites must exclude the prefix identically, or a `_archived-` directory would be invisible to the candidate scan but still poison the sibling-contradiction-key budget (or vice versa) -- the contract requires both, not either

fixScope.owner: cycle-state.mjs's resolveState() (both readdirSync(runsRoot) scans), shipped identically inside all six skills, their five dataset mirrors and pair-workflow-cycle's mirror

matrix.condition: a `_archived-<name>` directory carrying a compatible handoff set for the target story is excluded from the other-run/ambiguous-runs candidate scan
matrix.oracle: node --test .claude/workflows/pair-contracts/cycle-state.test.mjs -- (test name: "resolve: a runsRoot entry with the reserved `_archived-` prefix is never adopted as other-run, nor counted toward ambiguity")
matrix.expected: resolve() on an empty dir with only a `_archived-run-0/<story>` sibling returns status:'empty' (never 'other-run'); with a second, genuine `run-2/<story>` sibling alongside it, resolve() returns status:'other-run' runId:'run-2' (never 'ambiguous-runs', never adopting the archived one)
matrix.rationale: Before this fix, the archived directory alone was wrongly adopted as other-run (reproduced live: 136 redirected into `_archived-136-attempt3-cycle-codex-terra`); this row proves the exclusion for the candidate scan specifically.

matrix.condition: a `_archived-<name>` sibling never poisons the sibling-contradiction-key scan (the second readdirSync(runsRoot) site) -- an unrelated in-progress cycle in the target dir still resolves normally
matrix.expected: resolve() on a dir with its own published a0-red-spec handoff, and an unrelated `_archived-*` sibling for the same story present in runsRoot, still returns status:'in-progress' -- the archived sibling is never read for contradiction keys
matrix.rationale: The two readdirSync(runsRoot) sites are independent code paths; excluding the prefix at only one of them would leave the other scan still walking into archived directories.

matrix.condition: a genuine (non-`_`-prefixed) sibling run is still adopted or flagged ambiguous exactly as before -- this fix only ADDS an exclusion, never narrows adoption of a real candidate
matrix.oracle: node --test .claude/workflows/pair-contracts/cycle-state.test.mjs -- (test name: "resolve: with an empty run directory and a PR, other run directories of the same story are searched -- one match is adopted, several are ambiguous")
matrix.expected: unchanged: a single genuine sibling is adopted as other-run, two are ambiguous-runs, a legacy-schema sibling is reported but never adopted
matrix.rationale: Positive control: the pre-existing other-run/ambiguous-runs/legacy tests must keep passing unchanged -- this fix is additive only (an early `return false` / `continue` guard, nothing else touched).

supportingEvidence.description: Live redirect captured during the US-486 r0-5 kill/resume canary test itself, 2026-09-19/20.
supportingEvidence.observed: `.pair/working/runs/136-cycle-codex-v6` (story 136's prior canonical cycle, a terminal `unprovable` Branch-C attempt) was renamed to `.pair/working/runs/_archived-136-attempt3-cycle-codex-terra` to free the story for a fresh test run. reattest.reason: Test-first, exactly as r2-g4 through r2-g7: cycle-state.test.mjs's new resolve() test was written and confirmed RED against the unmodified resolveState() first (both readdirSync(runsRoot) scans reproduced the defect), then the `_`-prefix exclusion guard was added to both scan sites in all 12 production paths (6 skill copies + 6 dataset mirrors, verified byte-identical to each other both before and after), then confirmed green: 191/191 cycle-state.test.mjs, 77/77 cycle-coordinator.test.mjs (AC12-w3 mirror-identity check included, now covering all 6 locations), 799/799 pnpm workflows:test, pnpm format:check and pnpm skills:conformance clean -- all before this contract was written. The working tree is not dirty at these paths at seal time only if committed first; reattest lets the sealer verify by content hash instead of requiring an uncommitted change, matching the r2-g4..g7 precedent.
